# Meme formats

**On-brand memes and reaction posts: formats that last, trend timing, original images, rights and likeness rules, no punching down, labelled.**

Makes on-brand memes and reaction posts for an AI character or brand — picks a format family that still works (caption + reaction, reject/approve, POV, labelled scene, image macro, starter pack, escalation), times it against the trend, generates original reaction images with @useclaudia/media instead of reusing owned frames, sets the text, and runs rights, likeness, punch-down and labelling checks before approval. Use when someone wants a meme, a reaction image, a relatable post, to join a trend or meme format, or asks whether a meme is safe to post from a brand or creator account.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 20–40 min per meme | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Start from a shared truth
2. Pick a format family
3. Check the trend and the rights
4. Run the punch-down test
5. Generate the reaction images
6. Set the text and render
7. Label, caption and get a cold read
8. Publish while it's fresh
9. Watch the replies and retire the joke

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/meme-formats.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/meme-formats.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/meme-formats.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/meme-formats.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill meme-formats`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `meme-formats.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/meme-formats`.
